reasoning: 驗證目標：選取 Genres 時，將全部衛星電台依 Genre 排序後顯示。為什麼這樣切：條款的可觀察後果是次序——同一 genre 的電台相鄰成群；僅加上 genre 欄位而未重排的實作應失敗，故 ER 以分群次序表述而非以欄位存在表述（§8.4.1）。前置條件要求至少兩個 genre 且其中一個有多台，否則任何次序都通過。

tcs.tc_title: Selecting Genres orders the station list by genre
tcs.test_item: When Genres is selected, the HU shall sort and display the list of all satellite stations by Genre
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. At least two genres are represented among the receivable satellite stations and at least one genre holds more than one station
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the order of the stations in the list before Genres is selected
2. Select Genres
3. Read the order of the stations in the list
tcs.expected_result:
1. The order of the stations is recorded
2. Genres is accepted as a selection
3. The stations sharing a genre are grouped together in the list, and every receivable station is present
